transcript: You can now build a voice agent that answers in under a tenth of a second. It's called Fish Audio, and it starts responding in about 90 milliseconds, which is quick enough that the whole thing feels like a totally real conversation instead of a usual laggy one. It can also clone your voice from just a 10-second recording, and that clone can speak up to 83 languages. Plus there's an MCP, so you can wire it straight in your Codex or your preferred platform. Want to try this for yourselves? Just comment voice down below, and I'll send you the link directly.
